chapter: Package shows, Miami and the USO
title: Jazz concerts and preparing the 1952 USO tour
summary: Gigs at Stuyvesant Casino, then organizing the USO tour.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Where did you go from Delicate--where did you go from there?
We came back east and then we started doing jazz concerts. I broke up the band and we were just playing gigs. I was doing things down like the Stuyvesant Casino.
I did that and then I got the band back together and went overseas in '52.
So in other words, the rest of '50 and '51, you really were mostly doing single?
'52 is when you organized the band again and played the USO?
That's what I was going to say; it lasted one year.

It lasted one year. I first went to Alaska and stayed thirteen weeks. Sounds funny being a place like that, but we were playing every little place. I had my own plane assigned to me, with a crew. Then we came back here and had a week off and went to Europe.
Yeah, you were in Europe in '53.
I got into London June 30. I stayed all of July in England, all over England and went to France in August.
I got a picture of Alberta singing with you in France.
